name: @oh-my-pi/animations
description: Ambient animated TUI widgets for omp, as a single config-driven package.

omp.name: oh-my-pi animations
omp.description: Ambient animated TUI widgets for omp, as a single config-driven package.

animations.description: Shared motion tier for all animations (each still gates to 'off' on non-TTY/CI/NO_COLOR). Default 'subtle' is the curated native posture.

animationsBoxDetail.description: How much the Animations Box shows per enabled segment. 'detailed' gives one labeled row per segment. 'simple' composes everything into a single line. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

animationsBoxPlacement.description: Which side of the editor the Animations Box mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

animationsContextQuota.description: Context-window budget the Audit Box's top row fills against, as a percentage of the model's window — roughly where compaction lands. The bar and its turn forecast count down to this ceiling, not to 100%.

agentBonsai.description: Show Agent Bonsai inside the Audit Box when a subagent exists.

agentRosterDetail.description: Select compact or verbose activity text for exact agent rows.

agentRosterRetentionSeconds.description: Keep completed agents in the roster for this many seconds.

liveFiles.description: Show paths currently being edited or written in the Audit Box.

recurrenceStrip.description: Show whether recent turns are making heading progress or repeating a tool orbit.

contextRewriteShadow.description: Show the estimated transcript, provider-context, and stripped token counts.

compactionScar.description: Show tokens cut by compaction and immediate file re-reads.

consentLock.description: Show pending tool approvals as a blocking consent signal.

sessionPhylogeny.description: Show the active session node, branch depth, and sibling count after tree navigation.

thinkActLissajous.description: Show the latest assistant response's thinking-to-action balance.

errorIsotope.description: Show a normalized tool error only when the same signature repeats.

queueFog.description: Show when a queued follow-up will continue after the current turn.

skillChromatograph.description: Show skills actually used during the current turn.

retryRadar.description: Show active automatic retry and fallback progress.

goalHeading.description: Show the active goal objective, status, and token-budget heading.

memoryBackendTide.description: Show active memory backend state, writes, and recall activity.

darkroomTitle.description: Project critical animation state into the terminal title.

auditTrailBoxPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Audit Trail Box mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

auditTrailBoxAccentColor.description: Audit Trail Box's primary accent — the box badge (the per-status risk ramp stays fixed). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

breathingBorder.description: Breathe the Audit Box border instead of holding it steady.

breathingBorderPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Breathing Border mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

breathingBorderAccentColor.description: Breathing Border's primary accent — the border's peak brightness (the resting/mid-brightness tokens stay fixed). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

cacheMeterPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Cache Meter mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

cacheMeterAccentColor.description: Cache Meter's primary accent — the badge color (the invalidation alert stays fixed error-red). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

cadenceEqualizer.description: Show the Cadence Equalizer group inside the Audit Box.

cadenceEqualizerPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Cadence Equalizer mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

cadenceEqualizerAccentColor.description: Cadence Equalizer's primary accent — the burst bucket and the peak-hold cap (the cooler buckets stay fixed). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

rateLimitTidepoolPlacement.description: Which side of the editor Rate-Limit Tidepool mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

rateLimitTidepoolAccentColor.description: Rate-Limit Tidepool's primary accent — the water color (the near-empty sand alarm stays fixed warning-amber). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

reflectionRipple.description: Show the Reflection Ripple group inside the Audit Box.

reflectionRipplePlacement.description: Which side of the editor Reflection Ripple mounts on. Applied at wire time (restart to change).

reflectionRippleAccentColor.description: Reflection Ripple's primary accent — the ring (the calm-water background stays fixed dim). 'default' keeps the built-in palette. Applied at wire time (restart to change).
